programmes.d: The evo team returns to northern Scotland with eight of 2021's very best performance cars. Only one will win.
Jethro investigates whether or not Ferrari has created another masterpiece. Then, an epic road trip.
Head to Italy to drive the mighty Pagani Huayra and get a taste of the Veyron Vitesse. Then, a proper Ferrari?
Get under the skin of McLaren's special 789-bhp track car.
Which hot hatch will be faster around the super-quick Rockingham circuit? Then, the Cayman GT4 hits the track.
Drive a replica of the iconic Silverstone Circuit cut into a frozen lake. Then, meet the Vauxhall Maloo.
Dive into the P1's clever aerodynamic and cooling features. Then, see if it's faster than an RXC Turbo 500.
Take the 1244-bhp Hennessey Venom GT on the road. Then, the legendary Lancia Delta Integrale Evo II.
Harry Metcalfe drives a super-rare hypercar. Then, the greatest driving road in the world.
Join Harry Metcalfe in a convertible Bentley in snowy Spain. Then, put a Lambo through its paces in Italy.
Get a look at some stunning cars at the Quail show at the Pebble Beach weekend. Then, April fools.
Join Harry Metcalfe on the amazing three-day Lamborghini 50th anniversary tour.
Explore a new kind of electrified Mustang. Then, similar cars compete in the fun column.
Henry Catchpole introduces us to McLaren's first Sports Series supercar. Then, an R8 GT Spyder at Silverstone.
Jethro Bovingdon compares the F12 to the 599 GTO. Then, the M4 gets a true test.
Get a taste of the revolutionary 155-mph i8 hybrid car. Then, an unfair track battle.
Harry Metcalfe guides us through the history of the Lamborghini V12.
Trouble finds Danny when he makes a reckless buy at an auction. Will a hunk of junk force him to finally admit defeat?
Get revved up when Danny spots a killer 1967 Pontiac GTO at one of the biggest car shows in Vegas.
Scott bugs out when he learns Danny's invested in a vintage dune buggy. Will Danny prove Scott wrong and flip this sand shredder for some serious dough?
Pawn Stars Rick Harrison shows up to give the guys of Count s Kustoms the project of a lifetime.
When Ryan and Ghetto Bob buy a '67 Pontiac GTO, they don't realize that Danny misses his old GTO so much, he might not let the client have this one!

Danny and the crew go all in, building the ultimate, fully customized 1968 Dodge Charger, while Ryan and Shannon make a father and son's dream come true restoring their incredible 1959 Harley Davidson Panhead Chopper.
Danny and the guys can't wait to get started on a 1964 and a half Ford Mustang. But once they dig in, they find some creative and dangerous repairs, some they didn't even think were possible!
It's all hands on deck when Danny and the guys get to work transforming a 1960 Volkswagen Bus into a high end luxury beach cruiser. But an unexpected hiccup threatens to derail the whole project.
Danny trusts Horny Mike to paint a Medieval mural on a '73 GMC Pick Up truck, and soon regrets his decision.

Bo put his 1970 Corvette into storage thirty years ago. Dan discovers that the car needs repair of decades old vandalism. Steve’s 1964 GTO was smashed in an accident. Dan agrees to try and bring his mangled GTO back from beyond the grave.

Kansas City Royals pitcher Tim Collins wants a ‘super-fast’ 1968 Mustang, but Dan has to first undo a nightmare combination of bad repairs and unsafe systems. Bob needs a FantomWorks reality check to get his beloved 1950 Willy’s Jeep back on the road.

Nikkos wants a spectacular 1968 Mustang Fastback resto-mod. The all-metal masterpiece catches the eye of someone who wants it at any cost. Jim and Arlene want to enjoy their 45th anniversary in the same 1969 Firebird they rode in on their wedding day.

Mike’s 1939 Hudson Coupe-Convertible is the only survivor of three that were built. He wants Fantomworks to restore it to original condition – even though nobody knows what that looks like. Jim wants his 1970 Nova to be the ultimate dragster.

Joe challenges FantomWorks to build a replica of a legendary 1953 hydroplane that set a water speed record. Andy wants the perfect split window top for his 1963 corvette, but Dan finds hidden problems that launch a cross country search for parts.

Gary wants to restore a 1964 Mercedes 230SL, but his tight budget launches Dan into a headlong battle with a 50-year-old interior and a shattered cam shaft. Al wants to restore his father’s GTO, but FantomWorks discover it’s not the car Al thinks it is.

George wants his 1967 Chevelle to be perfect, but his car has had more rats than repairs and the engine bay is too small for his dreams. Brian’s 1960 Lincoln is full of surprises, and he moment something else is fixed, a new problem surfaces.

Michael wants a new convertible top for his 1953 Morgan, but the Fantomworks team has no reference, no template and no anchor points. Butch entrusted his 1969 Camaro to a restoration rip-off artist. Can Fantomworks fix the worst work they’ve ever seen?
The McLaren is in for the fight of its life on the track against a 911 GT3. Then, a battle of Porsches.
Take the ultimate pilgrimage for the performance car enthusiast. Then, the i30 N excels in northern Scotland.
Steve drives four different courses to reveal how to get the most out of the BMW performance car.
With eight cars remaining, the evo team explores the Scottish Borders for the final reckoning. Part 2 of 2.
The evo team tests 16 stunning cars to decide which contenders will make it to the finale. Part 1 of 2.
Dive into the devilish details of the McLaren F1. Then, witness the Audi S1 launch near the Arctic Circle.
